title: W1 multi-seed closure: C1 conditioning channel Δ(0) and ISAR augmentation gain (C5 protocol) on seeds 42/43/44
motivation: Two single-seed headline claims are extended to three seeds (42/43/44) with honest verdicts and 3-seed min/max ranges (NOT bootstrap CIs, per the headline_multiseed convention): (A) the conditioning channel Δ(0) of the C1 protocol (HRRP-conditioned FM, 1024/100 budget); (B) the ISAR augmentation gain of the C5 protocol (spread-equalized ISAR vs matched-budget HRRP-only control, both 512/60). Seed-42 assets already exist and are reused as the baseline; only seeds 43 and 44 are replicated here.
prereg_timestamp: 2026-09-26 (before any seed-43/44 training or audit in this experiment)

P_cond3.statement: The C1 Δ(0) (t=0.05 bin, per-dim MSE units, CFM conditional-loss gap L(t,null)-L(t,cond)) exceeds the pre-registered threshold 0.05 on ALL THREE seeds 42/43/44.
P_cond3.threshold_note: Seed-42 C1 Δ(0)=0.302 was reported as 'six times the pre-registered threshold' (roadmap §7.11), i.e. threshold ≈ 0.05.

P_isar3.statement: The spread-equalized ISAR Δ(0) exceeds the matched-budget HRRP-only control Δ(0) on ALL THREE seeds (the seed-42 +6.9% direction).
P_isar3.falsified_if: any seed has ISAR Δ(0) <= control Δ(0)

C1.inferred_from: c1_run.log (Stage 1 VAE reused from ./sat_model_scale_42, DDPM/FM epochs=100) + sat_model_c1/compare_gen.json (train_data=1024, test_data=32, vae_epochs=200, gen_epochs=100, T=100, seed=42, phase_mode=random) + roadmap §7.11 (HRRP conditioning, posterior-sample target, per-dim whitening, lr_cond=1e-4 - all script defaults)

C5_pair.inferred_from: c3_eq_run.log (spread-equalized ISAR, 512/60, VAE reused from ./sat_model_scale_42) + hrrp512_run.log (matched-budget HRRP-only control, 512/60) + sat_model_c3/ and sat_model_hrrp512/ compare_gen.json (train_data=512, test_data=16, gen_epochs=60, seed=42) + c3_eq_audit.log / c5_audit.log

audit.note: Block-3 CFM audit; reseeds with --seed BEFORE building the eval batch (fixed fm_seed=7). Audit flags match each seed-42 baseline: C1 audits run with --mc 0 --null_ab_epochs 0 (as info_audit_c1.json); C5-pair audits run with defaults --mc 48 --null_ab_epochs 15 (as info_audit.json / info_audit_c3_eq.json). Block-3 Δ(0) is invariant to those flags.

frozen_vae_note: Stage-1 PointVAE is frozen and shared across all seeds exactly as in the seed-42 C1/C5 runs (--vae_ckpt ./sat_model_scale_42, md5 95cc5622f36c03d6610d1b68e6fde59d copied into each model dir for the audit loader). The seed therefore varies the generative training + fresh per-epoch data sampling + the audit's reseeded eval batch; it does NOT reseed the VAE (the M3/scale per-seed-VAE convention was deliberately not used here, to match the seed-42 headline protocol exactly).

trainings_executed: C1 seeds 43/44 (--cond_feat hrrp, 1024/100, --vae_ckpt ./sat_model_scale_42, --save_dir ./sat_model_c1_s43 / ./sat_model_c1_s44) were trained 2026-09-26 22:43-23:57 in the same session (see w1_c1_s43_run.log / w1_c1_s44_run.log)
audits_executed: C1 audits used --mc 0 --null_ab_epochs 0 (matching info_audit_c1.json); C5-pair audits used full defaults --mc 48 --null_ab_epochs 15 (matching info_audit.json / info_audit_c3_eq.json). Block-3 Δ(0) is invariant to those flags (verified by the bit-exact fidelity check).
run_record.out_json_note: verify_info_audit.py gained an --out_json flag (default unchanged: isac_demo/info_audit.json) so multi-seed evidence never overwrites prior audit JSONs; every audit in this experiment passed an explicit --out_json.

fidelity_check: PASS (bit-exact): re-auditing the existing ./sat_model_c1 with the inferred protocol (--cond_feat hrrp, --seed 42, --mc 0 --null_ab_epochs 0) reproduced Δ(0) = 0.3019444942474365 with abs diff 0.0 vs isac_demo/info_audit_c1.json. The same check on ./sat_model_c3 (--cond_feat isar --spread_equalize) and ./sat_model_hrrp512 (--cond_feat hrrp) reproduced 0.15354037284851074 and 0.1436229944229126 bit-exact, validating the C5-pair audit flags. See fidelity_c1.log / fidelity_c3eq.log / fidelity_c5ctl.log.

43.source: isac_demo/info_audit_c5_isar_s43.json (./sat_model_c5_isar_s43) and isac_demo/info_audit_c5_ctrl_s43.json (./sat_model_c5_ctrl_s43), trained + audited this experiment

44.source: isac_demo/info_audit_c5_isar_s44.json (./sat_model_c5_isar_s44) and isac_demo/info_audit_c5_ctrl_s44.json (./sat_model_c5_ctrl_s44), trained this experiment
44.note: seed-44 ISAR channel functionally inert (delta_max_abs 0.0051 << 0.05 threshold); encoder not formally collapsed per audit criterion (collapse_confirmed=false, v_cond_vs_null_rel 0.063) but carries no usable information

P_cond3.detail: C1 Δ(0) = 0.3019 (s42) / 0.1902 (s43) / 0.2147 (s44); all three seeds exceed the pre-registered threshold 0.05 (min margin 3.8x). Variance explained Δ(0)/Var(x1) = 21.8% / 16.1% / 16.6%. Condition encoder not collapsed on any seed; CFM identity L=V+B residual <= 1.6e-07 on all seeds. The HRRP conditioning channel therefore replicates across seeds, with a 3-seed min/max range of [0.190, 0.302] (mean 0.236) - NOT a bootstrap CI.

P_isar3.detail: per-seed ISAR-vs-control gains: +6.9% (s42), +3.9% (s43), -99.2% (s44). The +6.9% single-seed claim does not replicate: on seed 44 the ISAR condition is functionally inert (delta0 0.0007 vs control 0.0906). Control delta0 itself varies 0.042-0.144 across seeds, so the channel width is seed-sensitive at this budget.

caveats: Each seed's audit reseeds its own eval batch (audit --seed = model seed), so the 3-seed comparison includes eval-batch variance in addition to training-seed variance (conservative direction), same as proposition M1. Concretely, the per-seed eval batches have different Var(x1) (1.387 / 1.179 / 1.295 for seeds 42/43/44), which is why the C5-pair Δ(0) levels differ across seeds; the meaningful comparison is the paired within-seed ISAR-vs-control gap (same batch), which is what P_isar3 tests.
n=3 with a shared frozen VAE: per-seed Δ(0) min/max is reported as the 3-seed range; no bootstrap CI is claimed (3-point bootstrap is a min/max envelope, per the protocol contamination audit).

Δ(0) is measured on a fixed 64-cloud eval batch per seed (fm_n_eval=64, fm_draws=4, fm_bins=10, fm_seed=7); batch-level noise of order the seed-42 null A/B gap (~0.26 max) bounds single-seed interpretability.

Seed-44 ISAR anomaly: Δ(0)=0.0007 with a non-collapsed condition encoder (unlike the G15 narrowband collapse). The failure mode is 'encoder alive but vnet ignores the condition' - a training outcome, not a measurable-information certificate; it is reported, not hidden, and it falsifies P_isar3.
C1 P_cond3 PASS: delta0 0.302/0.190/0.215 (3-seed range 0.190-0.302, mean 0.236), all >= 0.05 threshold; encoder non-collapsed and CFM identity residual <= 1.6e-07 on all seeds.
C5 P_isar3 FALSIFIED: seed-44 ISAR model functionally inert (delta0 0.0007, delta_max 0.0051); the matched-budget ISAR gain is a 2/3-seed result, not a stable effect.
Cross-seed comparison includes batch variance (each seed's audit uses its own reseeded batch) - conservative direction, same convention as proposition M1.
status: COMPLETE - C1 3/3 seeds (P_cond3 PASS); C5 pair 3/3 seeds (P_isar3 FALSIFIED 2/3)
